import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static String s;
    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[1000005];
    static long k, p;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static void dfs(int i) {
        if (!vis[i]) {
            vis[i] = true;
            dfs((int)((k * i) % p));
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        p = sc.nextLong();
        k = sc.nextLong();
        long ans = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
            if (!vis[i]) {
                dfs(i);
                ans *= p;
                ans %= MOD;
            }
        }
        if (k == 1) {
            ans *= p;
        }
        ans %= MOD;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
